IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:

Winds: East to southeasterly below 10 knots tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.

Friday 27 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then shifting northerly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny day. 60% chance of showers in the evening.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Northeasterly 10 to 15 knots shifting southwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the afternoon.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 95% chance of rain.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning westerly during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.

IDT12420.synoptic: A high to the east of the state is expected to slowly move away, across the Tasman Sea, until the end of the week while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania. A trough over Victoria will extend over northwestern waters on Friday then move over Tasmania on Saturday morning, before moving away to the east. A cold front arrives during the day Sunday.
